game.title: Grand Theft Auto V
game.blurb: Open-world crime action game from Rockstar North, released 2013-09-17 (PC 2015, re-released on PS5 and Xbox Series 2022). RAWG average playtime: 74 hours. Genre: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Michael, Franklin and Trevor's story, from the opening job to the ending you choose.

chapters.title: Strangers, Freaks and Side Activities
chapters.summary: Strangers and Freaks, hidden mysteries, collectibles, rampages, stunt jumps and businesses.

chapters.title: Money and Mods
chapters.summary: Stock market profits, big spending and fully modded cars and guns.

chapters.title: Exploring San Andreas
chapters.summary: Every part of Los Santos and Blaine County.

chapters.title: Rockstar Editor and Director Mode
chapters.summary: Making videos and playing as unlocked actors.

chapters.title: GTA Online

chapters.summary: Online heists, including The Doomsday Heist.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 271590)
StrategyWiki: outline of chapter names only, from its contents page (CC BY-SA 4.0) — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Grand_Theft_Auto_V
Fandom (gta.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://gta.fandom.com/wiki/Grand_Theft_Auto_V
notes: Steam app 271590 (the original 2015 PC release, now listed as Legacy; it is no longer in the store app list). The Enhanced edition (app 3240220, schema name "Charm") has the same 77 achievements. StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0) with 5 short subpages, no usable structure. gta.fandom.com answers the API with about 418 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 20 of 77 achievements are hidden; 8 of those are online heists, sorted by name.
